title: Impressum Contact Data Extractor
description: Extract requested company details such as name, address, email, and phone from website legal notices when available. Batch domains and choose fields and language for each lookup.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Company website domains whose legal notice you want to inspect.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain to search for impressum (e.g., example.com)

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated list of field names to extract (e.g., company_name,address,email,vat_id)

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code for extracted values (e.g., de, en, fr). Country names and other localizable values will be returned in this language.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated list of field names to extract (e.g., company_name,address,email,vat_id)

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code for extracted values (e.g., de, en, fr). Country names and other localizable values will be returned in this language.

maxResults.title: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Maximum dataset items to save across this entire run.
